recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is needed unless the work group later reverses FHIR-51930 or reintroduces one of the obsolete Substance* resources as an active build resource.
issue_request: FHIR-20855 is Published/Persuasive for R5. It reported that the R4 resource maturity tab listed SubstanceNucleicAcid, SubstanceProtein, and SubstanceSourceMaterial, but the categorized and alphabetical resource-list tabs did not, and asked whether they should be added.
initial_application: Jira records Grahame Grieve's GH#0a3fa2810d comment. Commit 0a3fa2810d90d4b0701369f5704fe9c820d326ef changed source/resourcelist.html to add the missing R4-era substance resource entries where they were absent from the resource index.
additional_context: FHIR-51930 is Applied/Persuasive for R6 and records a BR&R 9-0-0 decision to remove/delete SubstanceNucleicAcid, SubstancePolymer, SubstanceProtein, SubstanceReferenceInformation, and SubstanceSourceMaterial from the FHIR specification. The cited BR&R minutes confirm that motion, and the combined branch already contains e5842e71424820c971bc515b3c188fbb74063be2 auditing FHIR-51930. Current source/fhir.ini has active build entries for Substance and SubstanceDefinition, but not for the obsolete FHIR-20855 resources.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the three FHIR-20855 resources to the current categorized or alphabetical resource list would contradict the later R6 removal decision. The current resource list already includes SubstanceDefinition in both the categorized Medication Definition group and alphabetical list.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 BR&R decision removed the obsolete SubstanceNucleicAcid, SubstanceProtein, SubstanceSourceMaterial family from the active core specification, so FHIR-20855 should not be re-applied by re-listing them.
